decision_instructions: Which action does the support policy call for on this ticket?

criteria.0: refund: refund the order. Only when the order total is $500 or less and either (a) the ticket says the order has not arrived or asks where it is, the order status is Lost or is Shipped with a ship date more than 14 days before today, and stock is 0; or (b) the ticket reports a damaged or wrong item and the order status is Delivered with a delivery date 30 days or less before today
criteria.2: escalate: hand the ticket to a supervisor. Choose it when (a) the ticket says the order has not arrived or asks where it is, the order status is Lost or is Shipped with a ship date more than 14 days before today, stock is 0, and the order total is over $500; or (b) the ticket reports a damaged or wrong item, the order status is Delivered with a delivery date 30 days or less before today, and the order total is over $500; or (c) the ticket reports a damaged or wrong item and the order status is Delivered with a delivery date more than 30 days before today
criteria.3: reply: reply to the customer and take no other action
